sections.heading: C2 — Provisional-license penalties and disability parking, with restriction confusables
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Provisional-license penalties and disability parking, with restriction confusables

FACT_ID: sec11-F27 | anchor: A49
A conviction or Probation before Judgment for a moving violation while holding a Provisional License can mean a driver improvement program, a suspension or revocation, or both. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F28 | anchor: A49
When such a suspension or revocation ends, the license carries an employment and education only restriction. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F29 | anchor: A49
For a provisional driver under 18, a first moving-violation conviction or PBJ requires a driver improvement program. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F30 | anchor: A49
A second offense for a provisional driver under 18 brings a 30-day suspension and then a 90-day employment and education only restriction. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F31 | anchor: A49
A third offense for a provisional driver under 18 brings a 180-day suspension, a young-driver improvement program and a 180-day employment and education only restriction. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F32 | anchor: A49
A fourth or later offense for a provisional driver under 18 means revocation, and every licensing test must be passed again to regain the license. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F33 | anchor: A49
For a provisional driver 18 or older, a first offense requires a driver improvement program and a second brings a 30-day suspension. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F34 | anchor: A49
A third or later offense for a provisional driver 18 or older brings up to a 180-day suspension or a revocation. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F35 | anchor: A49
These MVA penalties come on top of any court penalties for the conviction. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F36 | anchor: A49
After each moving-violation conviction or PBJ you must start a new 18-month conviction-free period before you can get your license back. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F37 | anchor: A49
Misusing disability parking spaces, plates or placards can bring big fines. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F38 | anchor: A49
You may park in a disability space only with an MVA-issued disability plate or placard and with the qualifying person in the vehicle as driver or passenger. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F39 | anchor: A49
Parking in front of or blocking any part of a curb cut is a violation even if you hold a disability plate or placard. [A49]
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-F40 | anchor: A50
Parking on any part of the access aisle beside a disability space is a violation even with a plate or placard; the aisle is the space wheelchair and mobility-device users need to get in and out. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec11-F41 | anchor: A50
Using an expired placard, or a plate or placard without the disabled person present and proper identification, is a violation. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec11-F42 | anchor: A50
Any fraud or misrepresentation in applying for a disability plate or placard is also a violation. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec11-F43 | anchor: A50
A driver caught drinking and driving will have to install a breathalyzer car lock that keeps the vehicle from starting when alcohol is detected. [A50]
Source: [A50 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A49
Under 18, a second offense is a 30-day suspension plus a 90-day work-and-school restriction, while 18 or older a second offense is a 30-day suspension alone. [A49]
Why it matters: group_hint provisional-penalties; prereq_hint sec11-F27; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec11-F30, sec11-F33.
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A49
Revocation comes at a fourth offense for a provisional driver under 18, but a third offense can already bring revocation for one who is 18 or older. [A49]
Why it matters: group_hint provisional-penalties; prereq_hint sec11-R01; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec11-F32, sec11-F34.
Source: [A49 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A48
A suspension is temporary and may allow a restricted license, a revocation lasts until the MVA approves reinstatement, and a cancellation is never reinstated. [A48]
Why it matters: group_hint administrative-actions; prereq_hint sec11-F18; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec11-F21, sec11-F22, sec11-F24.
Source: [A48 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A47
The passenger restriction is limited to the first 151 days, but the midnight to 5:00 a.m. rule allows unsupervised driving only for work, volunteer, school or athletic trips. [A47]
Why it matters: group_hint provisional-restrictions; prereq_hint sec11-F03; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec11-F05, sec11-F08, sec11-F09.
Source: [A47 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0047]
